    Released 31 October 2026.
    Update character categories to Unicode 17. Feature #1569.

    TeX: Fix out-of-bounds write with long command. Issue #388, Pull request #382.
    Visual Prolog: Fix crash with deep nesting. Issue #388, Pull request #380.
    X12: Fix read into empty allocation. Issue #388, Pull request #385.

interactive.text: Generate default shortcuts.xml & contextMenu.xml on the fly
interactive.title:
Generate default shortcuts.xml & contextMenu.xml on the fly

Add disableNppAutoUpdate.xml to disable auto-update while WinGUp (GUP.exe) is present.

Follow https://github.com/notepad-plus-plus/notepad-plus-plus/commit/654e5312cc96c337e8d3b56d20869ad7ed614fc9

Fix #9755, fix #14279, fix #15120, close #17836

Update CONTRIBUTING.md to remove confusion

Comments like the following show that there is some confusion as to the requirements for Pull Requests:
- https://github.com/notepad-plus-plus/notepad-plus-plus/pull/18278#issuecomment-5840450059
- https://github.com/notepad-plus-plus/notepad-plus-plus/pull/17565#issuecomment-3975561463

In general:
- People have historically thought they needed to wait for the Issue to be `Accepted` before submitting a PR
- People get confused as to whether or not they need an Issue to attach their PR to
- People have historically asked to be assigned to open Issues, and never get assigned, so they never put in a PR (I know I have seen that in some of Issues I've read, but cannot immediately find an example)

I have tried to reword things so that those are all more clear, and match the current practices (don't need to wait for `Accepted`; almost always need to attach to Issue or comment; don't need to ask to be assigned to Issue)

Close #18469
